ORDER OF OPERATIONS: the keyless form was generated mechanically from questions.json with `jq '{questions: [.questions[] | {id, type, question, options, matching_options, scenarios} | with_entries(select(.value != null))]}'` (answer, rationale, distractor_patterns, primary_concept, theme, vertical and keywords stripped), every item was answered with confidence and a one-line reason, and those answers were written to disk BEFORE the key, any rationale or any prior eval artifact was read. items.reasoning: Fairness is measured by comparing outcomes across the under-represented group and reporting the disparity, not by notice, encryption or complaint sampling.
Reliability and safety means detecting when conditions fall outside what the model can handle and degrading to human control.
Privacy and security requires scoping data access per role and probing for extraction of personal detail, not signage or manual redaction.
Inclusiveness means testing with the excluded users and providing an alternative channel where the interface fails them.
Transparency obliges disclosing that the counterpart is an AI system and what its limits are.
Accountability is about a named human owner and the governance around the decision; logging and explanation serve other considerations.
Transparency is discharged by meaningful disclosure plus contest route; withholding exact weights is the privacy/security obligation in tension with it.
A generative model predicts tokens from pre-training patterns, which is exactly how a fluent but fabricated credit appears.
Fabricated dates are generation from learned patterns; lost opening pages are the fixed context window - one explanation covers both.
Image plus text in one request is the definition of a multimodal model.
A deployment carries its own configuration decisions made at deployment time, not just an on switch.
Reproducible identical output from identical input is a sampling-randomness question, so lower the temperature.

items.reasoning: Dictation-to-text and reading-out are Speech; scanned tickets to named values is information extraction; routing and recurring terms is text/NLP; camera hazard detection is vision.
Agentic means goal pursuit across steps with actions taken, not a bigger or better-writing model.
Salient terms a document is about is the definition of key phrase / keyword extraction.
Typed spans for people, places, organizations and dates is named entity recognition; text is already transcribed so OCR is out.
Mixed opinion in one message with a neutral whole-document score is the classic case for aspect-level sentiment.
Needing the substance of long prose without reading it is summarization.
Spoken audio to searchable text is speech recognition; the text tools then run downstream.
Held text to audio for a low-vision listener is speech synthesis.
Naming the product is image classification / labeling; counting waiting trucks requires located instances, i.e. object detection.
New visuals from written descriptions where no photograph exists is image generation.
Content type follows the medium as captured: photographs are images, call recordings audio, typed form entries text, dashcam footage video.
Named values straight into a system across many layouts, with no per-layout parsing, is field extraction rather than raw OCR.
Role, tone and prohibitions belong in the system prompt so they cannot be forgotten by the user.
The facts are right and only the shape is wrong, which is what few-shot worked examples fix.
Multi-step ordered arithmetic going wrong in sequence is what step-by-step reasoning prompting addresses.
A catalog model is not callable until a deployment of it exists; the project being reachable rules out the address.
External applications call the deployment's endpoint with its address and credentials.
The portal playground is the no-code way to test a model on real data before committing developer time.
Embedding the capability in an existing app means writing client code against the deployment with the Foundry SDK.
Portal testing against realistic requests is part of agent creation, not an afterthought handed to end users.
An agent is addressed as an agent through the SDK; it already carries its instructions and tools, unlike a bare deployment.

items.reasoning: Pasted-facts drafting needs only a prompt; live system lookups and end-to-end booking changes need tool-calling agents; explicit specialists reporting to a coordinator is multi-agent.
Grounding the agent in a knowledge base of approved procedures fixes both the wrong-source answers and the missing citation.
Fluency is not grounding; an untraceable clearance figure is exactly the failure grounding exists to prevent.
Three distinct requirements map to three techniques, and the application handles each structured result.
The agent needs the classification itself, so text analysis is attached as a capability the agent calls.
A multimodal model accepts the audio directly, removing the separate recognition stage.
Speech recognition and synthesis are Azure Speech capabilities in Foundry Tools, configured and called by the application.
Controlled consistent voice and vocabulary-tuned, latency-predictable recognition are the dedicated speech service's differentiators; the others point to multimodal.
Speech is composed around the existing agent: recognition in, synthesis out, agent unchanged.
High volume, fixed task, cost and shape constraints are precisely the case for the purpose-built text analysis capability.
Text techniques cannot read audio; recognition must precede classification.
Photograph plus a written question answered in prose is a multimodal call.
Producing images from a brief is a different model class from reading images.
Moving visual output generated from a description is video generation.
Reading images and producing images are separate capability classes, so two model classes are needed.
A proof of concept becomes an application when the prompt asks for the decision value and code writes it into the downstream system.
Printed permit number needs character reading; counting pallets needs located instances.
Named values from many document layouts without per-layout code is Azure Content Understanding.
Content Understanding covers images as a content type, so no separate image service is needed.
Content Understanding takes audio and video directly as content types, so the separate transcription hop is unnecessary.
One Foundry Tools capability spans text, image, audio and video content types.
Extraction only pays off when the downstream system consumes the values; accuracy is already proven.
Extraction configurations are per content type, so route each document type to the configuration built for it.
